IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight light brown hair walks a runway
in a black embroidered corset top with a
lace-trimmed neckline, a front button
placket, and a cropped hem. Black
straight-leg trousers and a small black
handbag with gold tassel detail complete
the look. She wears layered gold chains
and a gold heart pendant. Her
expression is calm and direct. A muted
gray-green runway with soft light. Palette
of black, muted rose, and gold. Refined
and romantic, in the style of a fall
runway show.
